package.description: High-performance driver indexing, matching, and servicing hub for bare-metal imaging and WinPE deployment.

en-US.description: High-performance driver indexing, matching, and servicing hub for bare-metal imaging and WinPE deployment.
en-US.longDescription:
ArkDeploy Driver Hub is a lightweight, high-performance driver indexing, matching, scavenging, and deployment pipeline designed for bare-metal imaging, OEM factory floor automation, and WinPE network servicing.

Features:
- Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) for immutable driver packages.
- Priority Specificity Engine with Plug-and-Play (PnP) CTE ranking (SUBSYS, DEV, VEN).
- Closed-loop driver scavenging from reference machines.
- Native Windows Service with zero-lock online SQLite backup.
- Built-in air-gapped web dashboard and compiled binary PowerShell client module.
en-US.name: ArkDeploy Driver Hub
